iree_select_compiler_opts(IREE_UK_COPTS_PPC_64_MMA
  CLANG_OR_GCC
    "-mcpu=power10"
    "-mmma"
)

# Power10 MMA accumulator builtins (__vector_quad, __builtin_mma_xvf32gerpp,
# etc.) are intrinsic to the compiler, not header-dependent (no <mma.h>
# needed), but availability still depends on the host compiler/version, so we
# probe for it rather than assuming -mcpu=power10 -mmma implies it.
string(REPLACE ";" " " CMAKE_REQUIRED_FLAGS "${IREE_UK_COPTS_PPC_64_MMA}")
string(JOIN "\n" IREE_UK_BUILD_PPC_64_MMA_TEST
"#include <altivec.h>"
"void f(vector float a, vector float b, float out[4][4]) {"
"  __vector_quad acc;"
"  __builtin_mma_xxsetaccz(&acc);"
"  __builtin_mma_xvf32gerpp(&acc, (vector unsigned char)a,"
"                           (vector unsigned char)b);"
"  __builtin_mma_disassemble_acc((void*)out, &acc);"
"}"
"int main() { return 0; }"
)
check_c_source_compiles(
  "${IREE_UK_BUILD_PPC_64_MMA_TEST}"
  IREE_UK_BUILD_PPC_64_MMA
)
unset(CMAKE_REQUIRED_FLAGS)

configure_file("config_ppc_64.h.in" "config_ppc_64.h")

iree_cc_library(
  NAME
    common_ppc_64

    iree::schemas::cpu_data
)

list(APPEND IREE_UK_PPC_64_DEPS "::ppc_64_mma")
endif()  # IREE_UK_BUILD_PPC_64_MMA
